caption: 💌 Do not forget to Save this for your next snack idea & FOLLOW ME for more healthy toddler-friendly snacks  🍎🍐4-ingredient Apple & Pear Slice  This is why I stopped buying packaged toddler snacks. This one is naturally sweet, soft, and full of fiber. 👩‍🍳 Recipe: 1 cup (200g) applesauce 1/3 cup (80g) soft dates (soaked, then blended) 1 cup (100g) oats 1 ripe pear, cut into small cubes 🍐 Mix everything in a small baking dish, and bake at 180°C for 20–25 minutes. The pear cubes caramelize slightly , it smells amazing and stays chewy even the next day. 💛 No sugar. No flour. Just real food  toddler-approved! #sugarfreesnacks #blwinspiration #apple  #GlowUpCetaphil #toddlerapproved
